concerns.text: T004 hardcodes `overlap=0.5` in `config.py`. Spec FR-003 and Constitution Principle VI explicitly state the overlap parameter is `[deferred]` in the planning stage. Hardcoding a value before the spec resolves this deferral violates the constitutional requirement to defer empirical values in planning docs.

T010a mandates exclusion if 'ICA fails to converge' regardless of channel rejection. Spec FR-002 only defines exclusion based on '>30% of channels rejected'. Adding a hard stop for ICA convergence failure introduces a new, undocumented constraint that may violate the research intent if ICA is unstable on noisy data, effectively weakening the data inclusion criteria defined in the spec.

T022a restricts the permutation test to shuffling labels 'only on the held-out test set'. Spec FR-007 requires assessing the significance of the 'regression model's R² value' (typically derived from the full cross-validation process). Restricting the shuffle to the test set alone may not correctly assess the global model significance as intended by the spec, potentially weakening the statistical validation requirement.

T015 outputs `features_clr.csv`, but T026d (and implied T026c_2 inputs) references `features.csv` (missing `_clr` suffix). This filename mismatch creates a broken dependency chain where the robustness modeling step cannot find the CLR-transformed features required by FR-010 and Constitution Principle VI, violating the requirement for a functional pipeline.

T035a validates `data/processed/features.csv` instead of the actual output `data/processed/features_clr.csv` generated by T015. This validation step will fail to find the artifact it is supposed to check, violating the requirement for schema validation of the final feature set.
